page.layout: One printed page, single text column on the right, running head at the top with page number at the right. Within the column: a running paragraph continuing from the previous page, two numbered argument paragraphs (Ratio II, Ratio III), an objection paragraph, a conclusion, then a division heading "Exercitatio VI." with a subtitle, followed by the opening paragraph with a large initial letter at the foot. No notes in the margins, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: ut[?] inter sese voluptatem & dolorem communicent: ita civitas optime regitur, cum ad affectionem unius hominis, quam proxime accedit.

Ratio II. ab effectu: Quia sic optime consulatur publicæ paci & benevolentiæ civium. Osten-datur a remotione causarum, ex quibus lites nascuntur: Vt sunt: inæqualitas fortunarum, cum alius abundat, alius eget: & dissimilitudo conditionis, cum alius est nobilis, alius rusticus. Ampl. ex antithesi ab incommodis proprietatis, quæ parit φιλαυτίαν, avaritiam, injurias, lites, furta, &c.
Ratio III. ab æquo & bono: Quia amicorum oporteat omnia esse communia. Cives autem bonos maxime amicos esse.

Objectio: Esse impossibilem. Resp. 1. per concessionem Platonis: addatur causa; id fieri ex accidente, propter φιλαυτίαν & avaritiam hominum. 2. per negationem Minoris. 1. quia Libyes, Cretenses & Lacedæmonii magna ex parte eam observarint. 2. Etiam apostoli olim in primitiva Ecclesia. 3. Etiam hodie Anabaptistæ alicubi.
Conclusio: Petere te tamen de istis amici sententiam.
main_text.head: Exercitatio VI.

head.i: Ad defensionem Platonicæ κοινωνίας omnium rerum, ex sententia Aristotelis Politic. lib. 2. cap. 1. 2. 3. Responsio.

main_text.p: EXordium à thesi: nec leviter probandâ: nec morosè

page.notes: The Greek words (φιλαυτίαν, κοινωνίας) are copied from the scan and may contain small printing irregularities. The opening word of the first paragraph is a faint, partly worn letter group read as "ut[?]". The word "probandâ" is read with some doubt from the scan. The margin on the left shows only the neighbouring page edge and show-through, which were left out.
